deviations.fact: All five assets were delivered as PNG with encoded separators in the filename and were converted to WebP at the exact specified paths. No stock image was substituted.
deviations.handling: all three proof cards render their photo; the typographic evidence plate remains the fallback if an ASSETS path is null

deviations.fact: /diagnosis is a technically distinct tool, so V5 forbids a blind redirect, while also forbidding two competing indexable product pages.
deviations.handling: kept live and functional, now noindex,follow and removed from the sitemap; product CTAs sitewide repointed to /first-move; /en/diagnosis untouched and still indexable
connect step gated behind FIRST_MOVE_ADS_OAUTH=enabled; no fake connection; Read-only is set up during kickoff until then

deviations.fact: no payment provider exists in the repository
deviations.handling: checkout is a binding request at the fixed price; lead source first_move_checkout; scope confirmation in writing, then invoice

deviations.fact: the public site has no tag manager and no consent banner
deviations.handling: no new script added; all fourteen V5 events are dispatched to window.dataLayer and window.gtag when present, otherwise a no-op

qualificationGuards: a non-200 entry page qualifies nothing; bot protection pages answer 403 with noindex, no H1 and no tag
